snippet.title: Petty Ungodliness - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
The gods are alive. They're just forgotten and working retail.

Petty Ungodliness is a tactical single-player roguelite deckbuilder set in a faded world where forgotten gods have lost their divinity. Ares, former God of War, now pulls espresso shots. Gaia, once the Earth Mother, sells cut flowers. Help them reclaim their powers and bring belief back into the world.

Build your deck and battle across three simultaneous lanes where every decision matters. Places of Power, runes and shifting slot counts change the rules of each encounter, challenging you to read the board, adapt your strategy and outsmart your opponent.

Choose your god and artifact, shape your deck across branching runs and deepen your relationships with the gods between attempts. Restore their trust to unlock new cards, abilities and stories as the grey world gradually bursts back into color.

Wishlist Petty Ungodliness now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4464190/Petty_Ungodliness/

Coming to Steam Early Access in 2027.

Play Petty Ungodliness at gamescom 2026 in Hall 10.2, Booth E051g at the Games/Bavaria booth.
